column3: With respect to the 535 & 545 5th Avenue Mortgage Loan (8.1%), the largest tenant at the Mortgaged Property, Empire Offices 535 Fifth Holdings LLC, leasing approximately 9.6% of the net rentable square footage at the Mortgaged Property as a co-working space, has not yet taken occupancy of approximately 88.8% of its space (the “Empire Expansion Space” ) pending the completion of the related build out. There can be no assurance that Empire Offices 535 Fifth Holdings LLC will take occupancy of the Empire Expansion Space as expected or at all.
